taxonomy.name: Software & bioinformatics
taxonomy.description: Programming, optimization, packaging, and computational workflows, including biological data processing.

taxonomy.name: Sequencing & biology
taxonomy.description: Sequencing technologies and biological analysis methods, rather than implementation details.

taxonomy.name: Population health & statistics
taxonomy.description: Disease incidence, population estimates, disease burden, and biomedical data modeling.

taxonomy.name: Clinical concepts & study
taxonomy.description: Anatomy, physiology, medical concepts, quizzes, and course questions. Quiz requests use this label even when the subject is a treatment technique.

taxonomy.name: Rehab techniques & assessment
taxonomy.description: Concrete assessment, treatment planning, exercise instruction, movement analysis, or clinical documentation. Grammar requests about these subjects keep their topic label.

taxonomy.name: Correspondence & logistics
taxonomy.description: Drafting messages, coordinating schedules and records, course feedback, and social replies, rather than medical or technical content.

taxonomy.name: Career & work
taxonomy.description: Employment arrangements, applications, and professional experience or learning-profile statements.

taxonomy.name: Mixed / other
taxonomy.description: Mixed subjects without a clear dominant topic in the retained user turns.
